These three subdirectories are static fixture archives used to test the archive detail handler and related utilities. `complete-archive/` contains a fully populated archive (manifest, state, mission state, token-usage log, spec, report, and reviewer verification) and exercises the happy-path where all fields and files are present. `missing-spec-archive/` is identical except it has no `spec.md`, exercising the handler's behavior when the original spec file was not snapshotted into the archive. `missing-reviewer-archive/` is identical to the complete archive except the entire `verification/` directory is absent, exercising the case where no milestone reviewer ran and `reviewerFindings` should return `null`.
